creator: PlantCatalog

modifications: Mesh simplified to a 0.35 target vertex ratio with a 0.001 error limit.
Textures resized to a 512 px maximum and encoded as WebP at quality 82.
Geometry quantized and compressed with EXT_meshopt_compression; the site GLTFLoader uses Three.js MeshoptDecoder.
educationalRole: A species-identified Delonix regia specimen mapped to the Krishnachura tree tile. It is a model example, not a claim that every local cultivar has this exact canopy or flowering state.
limitations: The source export is a static PlantCatalog plant model, not a photogrammetry scan and has no authored animation.
The Sketchfab viewer flagged the original as heavy; the local derivative was optimized from 26.82 MB to 3.32 MB for web delivery.
The source describes an old, thriving tree in spring. Seasonal appearance varies in Bangladesh.
